paperTitle: COEXIST: An Interactive Story Decision-Making Game for Mental Health Awareness
centralContribution: This work presents COEXIST, a short, interactive story decision-making game designed to increase mental health awareness, specifically focusing on self-care as a form of prevention against depression and social isolation. The game utilizes a metaphorical narrative, based on real experiences of undergraduate students during the COVID-19 pandemic, to immerse players in the perspective of someone struggling with depression and demonstrate the impact of daily choices.

elements.name: Paper Abstract
elements.description: Mental health is a critical public health issue, with 280 million people suffering from depression, impacted by complex lifestyle choices. Digital games offer potential for mental health awareness, empathy, and stigma reduction, but are underutilized for conditions like depression and social isolation, especially among students post-pandemic. This paper addresses this need by presenting COEXIST, an interactive story decision-making game, to break taboos and encourage self-care through an engaging medium.
elements.justification: Provides a concise overview of the paper's context, problem, and general approach, essential for understanding its relevance.

elements.name: Freytag's Pyramid Narrative Structure of COEXIST
elements.description: This diagram represents the narrative arc of the COEXIST game using Freytag's Pyramid model, illustrating key story stages: Exposition (introducing setting, protagonist, Mr Shadow, and the central conflict), Rising Action (exploring conflict and choices), Climax (protagonist falls without energy, Mr Shadow impassive), Falling Action (aftermath, continuous despair), and Resolution (two possible endings).
elements.justification: This figure details the core conceptual framework of the game's storytelling, which is fundamental to how COEXIST aims to convey its message about mental states and player agency.

elements.name: Protagonist and Mr Shadow Character Design
elements.description: This figure shows the character design for the main protagonist (an ice-white 3D humanoid) and 'Mr Shadow' (a black humanoid clone representing depression) from the COEXIST game. Mr Shadow's size dynamically changes based on player choices.
elements.justification: Introduces the central visual elements and metaphorical representations (protagonist vs. depression) crucial to the game's theme and interaction, directly supporting the paper's contribution of designing a game for depression awareness.

elements.name: Two Possible Endings of COEXIST
elements.description: These images display visual representations of the two distinct ending sequences from the COEXIST game: 'victory of depression' (a lifeless garden with an enlarged Mr Shadow) and 'victory over depression' (a lively garden with a significantly smaller Mr Shadow), demonstrating the consequences of player choices.
elements.justification: These figures are critical as they visually demonstrate the game's central mechanic of player choices influencing outcomes related to mental health, thereby reinforcing the game's educational message.

elements.name: COEXIST Game Climax Scene
elements.description: This figure presents screenshots from the COEXIST game's climax scene, showing the protagonist lying on the floor in dining, living, and kitchen areas with an impassive Mr Shadow nearby. This visually conveys a critical emotional moment, emphasizing depression awareness.
elements.justification: This figure visually communicates a pivotal emotional moment in the game's narrative, directly illustrating how the game portrays the struggle with depression through the interaction of the protagonist and Mr Shadow, thereby supporting the paper's contribution to mental health game design.
